response.en:
Get a Freight Quote

All our rates are customised to your shipment. To get a fast quote, please share:

1. *Origin* — city/state or port
2. *Destination* — city/state or country
3. *Cargo type* — description of goods
4. *Weight & dimensions* — kg and CBM
5. *Required date* — pickup or delivery deadline
6. *Special requirements* — hazmat, oversized, refrigeration, etc.

Send details to:
📧 info@yoongmei.net
📞 +60 16-723 9207 (HQ)
📞 +60 16-719 5800 (Puchong) — Rainbow
response.ms:
Dapatkan Sebutan Harga Pengangkutan

Semua kadar kami disesuaikan dengan penghantaran anda. Untuk sebutan harga pantas, sila kongsikan:

1. *Asal* — bandar/negeri atau pelabuhan
2. *Destinasi* — bandar/negeri atau negara
3. *Jenis kargo* — keterangan barangan
4. *Berat & dimensi* — kg dan CBM
5. *Tarikh diperlukan* — tarikh ambil atau hantar
6. *Keperluan khas* — bahan berbahaya, besar, sejuk beku, dll.

Hantar maklumat ke:
📧 info@yoongmei.net
📞 +60 16-723 9207 (HQ)
📞 +60 16-719 5800 (Puchong) — Rainbow
